title: publish-release.sh hard-refuses to publish without an opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt for the exact SHA and tarballs (OPAG-379 ruling 3)
description: Binding record: opum-doc docs/adr/harden-fleet-ci-against-a-single-runner-outage-and-unqualified-publication.md at origin/main 9222079, Decision ruling 3: publish-release.sh HARD-REFUSES to publish without a qualification receipt from opum-cli-e2e, unless an explicit override is written to the record it reads. Warning-only mode was considered and rejected (lore 0.9.0 shipped over a recorded NOT QUALIFIED result). The 0.9.2 release (LCLI-577) follows this by hand. This task makes it mechanical. FILED ONLY, on the orchestrator's instruction (2026-09-24T05:34Z). Implementation timing is the orchestrator's call. Open design points to settle against the ADR before building: where the receipt lives and in what format (the script must READ it, not accept a relay), and which fields bind it (release commit SHA, Release run id, the per-tarball sha256 that publish-release.sh already verifies).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The receipt location and format are agreed with opum-cli-e2e and cited by path
publish-release.sh exits non-zero before any publish when no receipt matches the version, run id and every tarball sha256; proven with a mismatched receipt AND a matching one as two measurements
An explicit override written to the record lets it proceed and is echoed loudly; no env var or flag alone bypasses it
--dry-run reports the receipt verdict without publishing

implementationNotes: RECEIPT LOCATION AND FORMAT agreed with opum-cli-e2e, 2026-09-25 (by message; e2e owns the writer and will file its own task). LOCATION: receipts/<product>/<version>.json on opum-cli-e2e origin/main, read with gh api repos/opum-ai/opum-cli-e2e/contents/receipts/lore/<v>.json?ref=main. CONSTRAINTS: (a) opum-cli-e2e is PRIVATE, so a public-repo GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read it. The reader must treat 404/403 as NO RECEIPT -> REFUSE, never as a retry that eventually passes. (b) e2e's main is promote-on-sight, so a receipt appears minutes after its PR merges. FORMAT: {schemaVersion:1, kind:'opum.qualification-receipt.v1' (the reader refuses an unknown kind), product, version, commit (40-hex), releaseRunId, runAttempt, tarballs:{<filename>: sha256} (from the release-run artifacts), verdict, counts:{pass,fail,blocked}, blocked:[row names], harness:{commit:<40-hex e2e SHA>, baseline:'baselines/<dir>'}, pairedWith:{quest:{version,commit}}, qualifiedAt, override?:{by,reason,task,adr:'<path>@<commit>'}}. The reader keys ONLY on verdict==='QUALIFIED' (the harness summary line reads NOT QUALIFIED on every run because the scale row is unbound, e2e TASK-107), plus a match of version, releaseRunId and every tarball sha256. An override is honoured only from the file, and printed verbatim on use. BYTES: the gate is only meaningful if the digest-checked tgz is the exact file passed to npm publish, with no repack (quest's win32 CRLF lesson, QCLI-368); verify publish-release.sh does npm publish <exact tgz>. OPEN: e2e points out that the ADR's Consequences section names publish-release.sh's refusal as opum-agent-owned implementation. The orchestrator ranked LCLI-578 first for lore-cli at 01:33Z, but confirm the reader is in lore-cli's scope before building. e2e offered to commit one example receipt as a fixture first: ask for it.

SCOPE RULED (opum-agent, 2026-09-25): the receipt reader in publish-release.sh is lore-cli's to build; lore-cli is the sole mutation owner of that file. The ADR's 'opum-agent-owned' names ownership of the RULING, not the code. Sequence: after 0.9.3's release-critical items (LCLI-575 + LCLI-571), and 0.9.3 does not wait for it.

IMPLEMENTED on feat/LCLI-578-qualification-receipt-gate, awaiting a reviewer pass (touches scripts/). Built against receipts/README.md + receipts/lore/0.9.2.json + 0.9.3.json read from opum-cli-e2e main d49ab79d on 2026-09-25. The gate runs after the digest checks and the local seal, before any credential or registry step. It binds kind+schemaVersion, product, version, releaseRunId (normalised digit strings), and tarballs by own-property lookup + set equality, with each sha256 recomputed from the exact $ARTIFACTS file publish_one hands to npm publish. Verdict QUALIFIED, or a complete four-field override printed verbatim. A partial override refuses even beside QUALIFIED; override:null counts as absent. Any gh failure = NO RECEIPT, never retried. Receipt repo/ref are constants, no env/flag bypass. It does not bind harness.commit, commit or runAttempt. Evidence: bun test test/publish-release-script.test.ts 43/43 green; 8 mutations each turned exactly the predicted subset red. Real positive control: scripts/publish-release.sh 0.9.3 36088480940 --dry-run (security stubbed, NPM_TOKEN empty) printed 'receipt: QUALIFIED (would proceed)', exit 0. BYTES: publish_one runs npm publish "$ARTIFACTS/<name>", no repack. npm 12.0.2 publish of a file spec streams its bytes via libnpmpack -> pacote.tarball.

REVIEW FIXUPS at 269b804e (PR #269). (1) Fail-closed: the verdict is now a positive-token case (QUALIFIED | 'OVERRIDE '?*), with die as the default. The checker's stdout and stderr are kept apart. The reviewer's repro (cat <<'JS' -> : <<'JS' with a NOT QUALIFIED receipt) now refuses with 'unrecognised output' and nothing is published. (2) The receipt read passes --hostname github.com. Measured with GH_HOST=ghe.example.invalid: the pinned read returned 0.9.3 QUALIFIED, and the unpinned read exited 1. (3) The stub serves the receipt only for host+Accept+exact path+ref=main; the ref=dev, host-removed and header-removed mutations each turned the predicted 30 of 45 red. (4) LCLI-572: the fail-once stub leaves a stale report behind. Removing the cleanup makes only the fail-once test red (AMBIGUOUS). Real 0.9.3 dry-run on 269b804e: QUALIFIED, exit 0. Incidental real-gh LCLI-572 evidence: with GH_HOST redirected, the report download printed gh's 'error connecting to ghe.example.invalid' on attempt 1, retried, and died with that text.

Closing evidence, re-measured by the dispatching session on 2026-09-25 against head 6f6eaf54 (not relayed). AC2 MATCHING: scripts/publish-release.sh 0.9.3 36088480940 --dry-run on real release artifacts printed 'receipt: QUALIFIED -- version 0.9.3, run 36088480940 and all 7 tarball sha256 match', exit 0. AC2 MISMATCHED: the same real artifacts with ONLY the root tarball re-gzipped (identical tar stream, sha256 341a448a... vs receipt c70fd8db...), run on the REAL publish path (not --dry-run) with npm shimmed to log and fail, exited 1 with 'sha256 MISMATCH for opum-ai-lore-0.9.3.tgz' and ZERO npm invocations. AC3: proven by the stubbed suite (full override on NOT QUALIFIED proceeds and prints it verbatim; a partial override refuses; SKIP_RECEIPT, LORE_RECEIPT_OVERRIDE and GH_HOST on a missing receipt all refuse). No real receipt with an override exists to measure live. AC4: the matching dry-run above also printed 'receipt: QUALIFIED (would proceed)'. A refusing receipt stops a dry-run with exit 1 (stub-tested). Focused suite: 45 pass, exit 0. Reviewer pass (opum-workflow reviewer) found no blocker. Its findings 1-4 were fixed in 269b804e and mutation-proven, and findings 5 and 6 were routed out (opum-cli-e2e, and LCLI-586).
finalSummary: scripts/publish-release.sh now hard-refuses to publish unless receipts/lore/<version>.json on opum-ai/opum-cli-e2e main (read with gh api --hostname github.com, raw media type; host, repository and ref are constants) has kind opum.qualification-receipt.v1, product lore, the same version and releaseRunId, a tarballs map set-equal to the seven downloaded files with every sha256 matching the exact file npm publish is handed, and verdict QUALIFIED or a complete override {by, reason, task, adr} that is printed verbatim. Any read failure, including 404 and 403, means no receipt and refuses. The checker must print a positive token, and anything else refuses. The gate runs before any credential read or registry call. --dry-run reports the verdict and exits 1 on refusal. --verify-only is untouched. harness.commit, the receipt's commit and runAttempt are deliberately not bound, per the contract. As a side effect, the root launcher tarball, which had only a local self-seal, is now bound to a digest recorded in another repository. Verified: 45-test stubbed suite plus mutation table on the PR; a real 0.9.3 dry-run passes the gate; the real publish path with a re-gzipped root tarball refuses with zero npm calls; an adversarial reviewer pass with its findings fixed. Delivered in opum-ai/lore-cli#269; CI run 36100119858 green on the pre-review head, and the final head's run gates the merge.
